verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Deel's MCP server has a createTimeOffRequest tool and exposes 'time data'. Submitting a single time-off request is an adjacent capability. Nothing documents defining PTO policies, accrual rules, approval workflows, or time off flowing automatically into payroll.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define PTO policies with accruals and approvals that apply automatically to payroll
